objective.symmetric_InfoNCE: Mean of row-wise and column-wise in-batch cross-entropy on cosine similarities, with the paired recording on the diagonal
objective.classification_embeddings: Unnormalized final-token 32-dimensional outputs; a single learned Linear(32,6) head is shared across modalities
objective.batch_sampling: Same seeded with-replacement clip indices across models; repeated clips can create contrastive false negatives, identically for every model

initialization.shared_components: Both modality frontends, both modality output projections and the shared classification head have identical initial tensors across model families for each paired seed
initialization.parameter_matching: Both backbones together must have max-minus-min parameter gap no larger than 3% of maximum. All parameters are active; no padding. Resident and trainable totals, each modality and head are reported separately. Same data, dt, optimizer, tuning count, contrastive negatives and evaluation suite.

cohort.normalization: Training actors only; frozen low-level decoder and separate modality moments
cohort.timing: Use stored dt unchanged: dt=10*elapsed_seconds per segment; HCSN physical scale0.1 restores seconds. No dt=1 override.
cohort.causality: Full-clip resampling is offline preprocessing. This experiment is not causal media streaming.

selection.development: For each model, train both learning rates on training actors only; evaluate validation actors at update48 and96. Select minimum FP64 fused validation cross-entropy, tie by earlier checkpoint then lower learning rate.
selection.formal_checkpoint: Train from a fresh paired seed with development-selected LR. Fixed-budget validation at update128 and256; equal-CPU validation at the first complete update crossing30 and60 training CPU seconds. Select minimum FP64 fused validation CE, tie earlier update.
selection.heldout_guard: Atomically write and fsync selected checkpoint identity and selection.json before opening test arrays. No test logits, retrieval ranks, calibration or shuffled-pair metrics enter LR/checkpoint selection.
selection.validation_reuse: The six validation actors are reused for LR and checkpoint selection; external evaluation remains on eight disjoint test actors. No claim that validation is an independent confirmation set.
selection.no_reselection: Freeze all model-specific LR choices before any formal worker accesses test. No seed filtering, test-driven architecture selection, or silent job rerun.

evaluations.retrieval_ties: Higher cosine first; exact ties broken by original frozen row index
evaluations.shuffle_rule: Outcome-independent derangements generated with a fixed seed882901+split_index: permute indices then cyclically rotate. A second derangement rotates independently within each actor. Store exact mappings. Audio labels remain unchanged.
evaluations.raw_evidence: Every validation checkpoint and formal test stores raw modality embeddings, all classification logits, labels, clip and actor identities, global/same-actor retrieval ranks and both derangements. Store selected and final weights, optimizer-free tensor hashes, complete per-update losses/gradients, physical diagnostics and update groups.
evaluations.shuffle_interpretation: Independent encoders and a shared linear mean head are an additive fusion probe. A loss under mispaired modalities measures mispairing sensitivity; it is not by itself evidence of cross-modal synergy or general content understanding.

primary_statistics.endpoint: Paired difference in actor-balanced test fused accuracy: value_jg minus each of the four controls, separately for fixed updates and equal training CPU
primary_statistics.independent_population_units: Eight test actors. The 192 clips are not treated as 192 independent people.
primary_statistics.bootstrap: Crossed resampling: draw eight paired model seeds and eight test actors independently with replacement; compute the paired difference over the crossed seed-by-actor matrix. Keep all clips within a selected actor together.
primary_statistics.intervals: Report ordinary2.5%-97.5% percentile intervals and a one-sided Bonferroni lower percentile at0.05/8 for the predeclared eight positive-benefit contrasts. These are approximate intervals with only eight actors, not exact finite-sample guarantees.
primary_statistics.positive_gate: All90jobs valid; each model's same-information/parameter contract passes. A contrast needs mean fused-accuracy gain>=.02 and multiplicity-adjusted lower bound>0; mean Brier may not worsen by>.01 and ECE by>.02. A general external-net-benefit claim requires all eight contrasts to pass. Equal-training-CPU evidence alone is not a complete-worker/hardware energy advantage.
primary_statistics.retrieval_and_shuffle: Secondary descriptive diagnostics. Actor resampling of per-query ranks conditions on the fixed retrieval candidate pool; it does not resample the candidate population. No architecture superiority gate is selected from these outcomes.
primary_statistics.seed_pairing: Same initialization seeds and batch-index streams across arms for fixed updates. Equal-CPU arms share the same prefix but usually take different numbers of updates.

costs.training_clock: Complete forward, multi-task objective, backward, finite-gradient/probability audits, gradient clipping and Adam; excludes validation, model construction and checkpoint serialization, which are included in whole-worker cost.
costs.full_worker: Exact child PID wait4 CPU and launch-to-exit wall time, including Python imports, data loading, model initialization, train/validation/test, retrieval, checkpoint and evidence writes. Do not add contained training/evaluation clocks again.
costs.shared_costs: Acquisition, decoding, normalization, transport restore, registration, hyperparameter search, analysis and packaging remain separate receipts. All failed attempts count; media decoder CPU must not be added twice from nested stage receipts.
costs.inference: Selected model, both modalities plus shared head, in-memoryB16T32, one warmup and five repetitions; CPU and wall distributions reported separately from complete request cost.

preflight: Synthetic audio/video tensors and positive nonconstant dt only; no real cohort array or previous test split is loaded. Verify all five models, finite losses/gradients, actual updates, shared initialization, full-count match, retrieval/tie/derangement contracts and actual elapsed-time propagation before sealing.
limitations: Acted CREMA-D emotion and same-recording alignment on30newactors; not general multimodal language modeling
Fixed low-level audio/video features and small32-dimensional encoders; no foundation-model scale
Inherited affine J/G remain a surrogate for the content objective; finite task oracle is a separate result
Two learning rates and96development updates provide an equal tuning budget, not exhaustive baseline optimization
Pinned Mamba-1 is a serial CPU reference; no fused CUDA speed or energy comparison
Eight heldout actors limit population inference even with eight initialization seeds

data_binding.rule: Registration reads the exact transport blob from git show commit:path, verifies its Git blob and every restored file, then retains this proof. No model outcome selected this data evidence.

integrity_analysis: Reconstruct every unique stage/model/seed/LR job from this design and the development argmin. Verify every update1..N, finite losses/gradients/probabilities, first complete crossing of the CPU budget, exact midpoint/final validation, selected/final tensor hashes, global LR-lock identity/timestamp, raw logits/ranks/derangements, and actor/clip identity. Loss-component sums use2e-6 relative/absolute tolerance only for float32 arithmetic; FP64 evaluation summaries use2e-10.
preseal_amendments: Independent review added exact committed transport binding, full90job matrix reconstruction, complete-trajectory budget validation and global selection-lock chronology before any real cohort prediction. Synthetic preflight001 remains preserved; source-bound preflight002 follows these repairs.
